title: Add the INDIGO document header to PLATESOLVER.md
description: Add the Revision, Author and e-mail lines directly below the existing title of indigo_drivers/agent_platesolver/doc/PLATESOLVER.md, matching the spacing, date format and emphasis in the adjacent Scheduler technical reference. Proposed metadata: revision 20.11.2026 and Peter Polakovic <peter.polakovic@cloudmakers.eu> from the commit introducing the consolidated guide, subject to owner correction. Preserve the original index-format attribution in the existing section. Verify the diff is confined to the header.

Owner-approved PLATESOLVER.md is byte-identical to 544e0ac9. Maintained-document inventory covers plate/astrometry/ASTAP and solve/solver/solving variants; unchanged hits are historical status/changelog records, executable HTML controls or generic problem-solving text, with vendor/Factory archives excluded. Verified 53 changed-line Markdown link paths; compiled operating links resolve to indigo://help and optional native references retain the canonical GitHub URL. MCP help --check passed for 18 documents; decoded baseline J2000 synchronizations match existing source manuals. Retired SOLVER_INDEX_FORMAT.md remains absent with no maintained references. Whitespace check passed and worktree is clean. No application behavior changed; runtime/hardware tests are not applicable. No blocking findings.
